# Gavin Reis

> Electrical & Computer Engineering at Cornell. I design systems end to end and
> put them in front of real users.

Personal engineering portfolio. Static site, no tracking beyond privacy-friendly
page analytics. Everything here is real: every project links to something running,
and work that isn't deployed is listed as in-progress rather than written up.

## Projects

- [John Savoretti Realty](https://gavinr.dev/projects/john-savoretti-realty):
  Production site for a two-office Long Island brokerage. Residential, rental and
  commercial listings share one typed pipeline built on TypeScript discriminated
  unions. Live: https://john-savoretti-realty.vercel.app/
- [GC Kuts](https://gavinr.dev/projects/gc-kuts): Mobile-first site for an
  independent barber whose funnel runs through Instagram.
  Live: https://gckuts-site.vercel.app/
- Above All Tents: First site designed, built, shipped and sold end to end.
  Live: https://abovealltents.com/
- The Ledger: Prototype exploring how to present reporting without editorial
  slant. Runs on sample articles, not live news.
  Live: https://the-ledger-ashen.vercel.app/

## In progress (no deployment yet)

- Canvas Course Archiver — archives Cornell Canvas courses into a queryable manifest
- ECE Course Tutor — retrieval-augmented tutor over that archive, with citations
- PDF Reader — reads a PDF aloud with the current sentence highlighted
- Inkline — handwriting-to-text with a CER/WER eval harness as the release gate
- AI legal triage — jurisdiction-aware legal information tool, gated on escalation-recall evals
